name: SML Mahindra Limited
trendlyne_description: SML Mahindra Ltd. (formerly SML Isuzu Ltd.) is a prominent player in the Indian commercial vehicle (CV) industry, specializing in the light and medium commercial vehicle segments. Established through a historical partnership with Sumitomo Corporation... Read More
screener_description: SML ISUZU LIMITED was incorporated as Swaraj Vehicles Ltd in 1983 and was promoted by Punjab Tractors Ltd with technical collaboration  Mazda Motor Corporation, Japan, and Sumitomo Corporation, Japan. In 2004,  the technical collaboration agreement with Mazda expired 2004 and sold its entire stake to Sumitomo Corporation and in the same time, it signed a  technical assistance agreement with Isuzu Motors. In 2011, it was renamed as SML ISUZU and Sumitomo Corporation(Japan) and Isuzu Motors(Japan) own 44% and 15% stake, respectively [1]
